depiction.primary_object: standing human figure silhouette inside a circular arrow
modifiers: clockwise circular arrow around the figure
depiction.composition: centered figure enclosed by a clockwise circular arrow

readings.meaning: switch user / change account / reassign person
rotate duty / shift rotation / staff turnover

ambiguity: ORIGINALLY means auto-rotate screen lock in Android UI, and at very small sizes the figure inside the circle can look like an 'i' (information) icon or a power button.

modifier_semantics.meaning: refresh, update, rotate, switch, or repeat

task_intents: reassign task or ownership to someone
follow up with a person regularly

example_tasks.task: Change emergency contact in HR portal to Sarah
Swap weekend pager shift with Marcus next month
Refresh headshots and short bio on the company team page
Transfer domain ownership and billing account over to new client
Hand over release manager role to Priya for the April sprint
Switch primary pediatrician in the clinic portal before the July checkup
Update beneficiary details and maiden name on the vanguard account
Move the shared Apple ID on the kitchen iPad over to a dedicated family account
Fill in the new address and phone number

example_tasks_es: Actualizar los datos de contacto y perfil en el portal de recursos humanos
Rotar el turno de guardia del fin de semana con Javier
Cambiar el titular del contrato de internet a nombre de Lucía
example_tasks_ru: Обновить анкету и портфолио на Хедхантере
Поменяться дежурством в субботу с Антоном
Переоформить лицевой счёт за интернет на нового жильца

context_tasks.task: Take a new portrait photo for the staff directory
Write handover notes for the incoming treasurer
Draft email announcing the new team lead rotation
Export vCard backup before wiping the old phone

near_misses.task: Turn off screen auto-rotate before reading in bed
Renew passport before the October trip
Find out when the visitor center opens
Return library books on the way home
Buy gifts for the new hires

reasoning: Literally depicts a standing person silhouette encircled by a clockwise arrow. While it originates as a UI glyph for portrait screen rotation, in a task planner it naturally reads as updating a user profile, switching accounts, rotating shifts/duties, or reassigning a person. At small sizes it could be mistaken for an 'i' info circle.
